1.0 INTRODUCTION:

1.1 To ensure uniform care of patients with all statutory compliances

2.0 SCOPE:

2.1 Hospital Management

2.2 Health Care Providers

2.3 Patients

2.4 Government agencies

3.0 RESPONSIBILITY:

3.1 Doctors, Hospital Management

3.2 Nursing staff

4.0 ABBREVIATIONS:

4.1 AAC - Access Assessment and Continuity of Care

5.0 DEFINITION: Nil

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards For Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1 Discharge summary is provided to the patients at the time of discharge.

7.2 Discharge summary contains the patient’s name, unique identification number, date of admission and date of discharge.

7.3 Discharge summary contains the reasons for admission, significant findings and diagnosis and the patient’s condition at the time of discharge.

7.4 Discharge summary contains information regarding investigation results, any procedure performed, medication administered and other treatment given.

7.5 Discharge summary contains follow-up advice, medication and other instructions in an understandable manner.

7.6 Discharge summary incorporates instructions about when and how to obtain urgent care.

7.7 In case of death, the summary of the case also includes the cause of death.

8. 0 PROCESSES :-

8.1 Discharge summary is provided to the patients at the time of discharge.

8.2 Discharge summary contains the patient’s name, unique identification number, date of admission and date of discharge.

8.3 Discharge summary contains the reasons for admission, significant findings and diagnosis and the patient’s condition at the time of discharge.

8.4 Discharge summary contains information regarding investigation results, any procedure performed, medication administered and other treatment given.

8.5 Discharge summary contains follow-up advice, medication and other instructions in an understandable manner. Also explained by treating doctors, post graduate students and nursing staffs in patient language

8.6 Discharge summary incorporates instructions about when and how to obtain urgent care, whenever necessary

8.7 In case of death, the summary of the case also includes the cause of death
